pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome to Elmhurst Prep School | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Elmhurst Prep School
From our Nursery, Little Elmhurst, through to our Year 11+ preparations in a supportive environment that develops character and confidence, our young learners are encouraged to be kind, curious, respectful, determined and brave.
ADMISSIONS
Every pupil that joins Elmhurst is valued, and their journey through the school will be a unique one.
TESTIMONIALS
The teaching staff go above and beyond with learning and experiences. The pastoral care is excellent and my child has thrived at Elmhurst.
This is my second child at the school, the environment, the staff, the vision and close knit community feel have definitely ensured both my children have flourished and, above all, have had the happiest, most enjoyable time.
Start Your Journey
Enter your childs date of birth below to start the admissions process
FeesAffordable Excellence
Nursery
We provide year-round nursery care for children from the age of six months to school age. We are open Monday to Friday, from 08:00 until 18:00, for 51 weeks of the year.
School
In addition, we offer alternative tuition only packages. Further details and a full breakdown of fees can be found here.
OPEN DAYS
NEWSLife at Elmhurst
Determination: The “Elmhurst Edge” in Action
Head’s Blog: Finding the balance – how the right school can enable families to thrive
Primary School Offer Day: What to Do Next
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

pageCache.pageTitle: Wraparound Care | Independent School | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
To support our working parents we offer wraparound care during term time. Details of the bookable sessions are below. Any parents wishing their child to attend a session should book using Magic Booking. This enables us to ensure adequate supervision of pupils at all times.
Breakfast Club
Breakfast club runs for all school age pupils from 7:30am – 8:15am daily. Children will be offered breakfast. Sessions can be pre-booked on Magic Booking.
Drop in (no booking)
After School
The school operates a staggered end to the day to minimise car park congestion. After dismissal any child remaining on site must be booked into an activity or club.
3:00 – 4:00 Afterschool Club £4
4:00 – 5:00 Afterschool Club £8
5:00 – 6:00 Afterschool Club £8
All pupils attending the after school club from 4:00pm, will be offered a light tea.
Late collection (after 6pm)
£25 per fifteen minute session
Elmhurst offers a dynamic Holiday Club during the half-term and summer breaks, providing children with a screen-free environment filled with arts, craft, and sports activities. This program ensures that children stay engaged and active during school holidays, fostering creativity and physical well-being. For more information, please click here.
Staff
For further information on the wraparound care provision or for help with a booking please email the School Office.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

If you have an idea for a club, please get in touch with clubs@elmhurstschool.net.
At present, we offer the following after school clubs:

pageCache.pageTitle: Inspection Report | Private School | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
Please click on the link below to read our latest ISI Regulatory Compliance Report.
A few highlights from this report:
The leaders’ vision for the school is shared by all its stakeholders. Its values of determination, curiosity, bravery, respect and kindness are evident throughout the school. Leaders’ commitment to knowing every pupil so that they are able to adapt to the ‘brilliance in every child,’ is evident in all interactions between pupils and staff.
Staff use assessment information effectively to track pupils and provide additional support so that pupils achieve to the best of their ability. Teachers are supported to identify and meet the needs of all pupils. The analysis of data, combined with the leaders’ deep knowledge of individual pupils, ensures lessons are well planned so that pupils make good progress.
Pupils of all abilities attain well and the results of 11+ examinations to highly selective schools reflect the school’s aim to deliver 11+ preparation in a supportive environment. Pupils are awarded a wide range of scholarships.
The school delivers a broad and well-planned topic-based curriculum which enables all pupils to learn and make progress. The provision of opportunities for pupils to participate in a curriculum which develops all areas of learning is further enhanced by regular reviews so that themes reflect the pupils’ interests.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

We invite families to attend an Open Morning, which will include a tour of our facilities and an opportunity to meet our dedicated staff and engage in informal discussions with our Head, Mrs Sara Marriott.
These visits provide a first-hand look at our dynamic learning environment and the chance to see our values in action.
Experience the vibrant atmosphere of Elmhurst and learn how we cultivate a love of learning and personal growth in every boy and girl.
Autumn Open Morning

Register your place using the form below, or read on for information about private visits.

By visiting Elmhurst in person, families will discover a school that not only emphasises academic excellence but also the holistic development of each child. To book a private visit, please email admissions@elmhurstschool.net.
We look forward to showing you why Elmhurst School is the perfect place for your son or daughter’s educational journey. In the meantime, if you have any questions, do please contact us at: admissions@elmhurstschool.net.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

pageCache.pageTitle: Registration | Prep School Surrey | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
Registration Fee
If you’re looking to pay the Registration Fee of £100, our details are as follows:
Sort code: 20-95-87 Account Number: 23640442
Please use pupil’s name as the reference when making payment. If you would prefer to pay by another method, please contact the School Office on 020 8688 0661 or email admissions@elmhurstschool.net.
Consideration of an offer of a place
As a small caring school, we are able to offer most pupils a place to experience a wonderful journey through preparatory school. In considering applicants, we aim to ensure that any child offered a place at Elmhurst will be able to fit happily into the school and be able to benefit from and cope with the challenging, broad curriculum we provide. We always look beyond the current ability of the child and try to gauge their possible potential in our assessment process, which is conducted individually for all age groups.
Offers for places at the school are made following assessment. Those entering scholarship applications may be asked to take part in an additional assessment depending on the individual situation.
Accepting a place
Once a place has been offered, your child’s spot will be held for seven days. A deposit of £700 is then payable upon acceptance. This deposit will be returned when your child leaves Elmhurst in Year 6, subject to any outstanding amounts. It is non-refundable in the event your child does not join the school.
If you have any questions about the application process, our Admissions Manager can be reached via email on admissions@elmhurstschool.net or by telephone on 0208 688 0661. You can also complete our online form and someone will get in touch with you.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

pageCache.pageTitle: Prep Curriculum | Prep School London | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
With a clear 11+ journey in mind, our curriculum is designed to engage young minds and build a love of learning, whilst ensuring robust skill development that supports preparations for senior school transition. Many of our children will go on to highly selective independent schools and local grammar schools, therefore, an Elmhurst education seeks to accelerate learning and support our pupils to thrive in ambitious academic environments. We organise our collective efforts through our Elmhurst EDGE programme
Verbal and non verbal reasoning are taught from Key Stage 1, alongside problem solving skills whilst instilling a love of learning. Behaviours for learning are instilled ensuring our pupils’ intrinsic motivation to succeed is high. Pupils are encouraged to take responsibility for their learning journey. Pupil mentoring throughout the school ensures pupils are actively reflecting on their own progress and regular opportunities to self reflect in class work. Parents are actively sought as partners in this. Termly open classroom events, parent/pupil workshops and feedback forms pre and post parent reporting optimize support for the children.
Alongside our academic drive, children experience a life skills curriculum that supports the development of character education, financial literacy, use of AI alongside personal, social and emotional health. This ensures our offer is balanced and broadly based, and strongly promotes the personal development of our pupils.
Each term a Curriculum Plan Overview is shared with parents, providing insight into the planned journey for the term and creating opportunities for supporting learning at home and every term boys and girls will enjoy at least one enrichment opportunity to add to their experiences.
The curriculum up to Y6 aims to marry together the strengths of the revised National Curriculum in the Primary Years with the entrance requirements of the selective senior schools to which pupils apply and the next phase of their education alongside the aims and ethos of the school.
Specialist Teaching
Teaching is, of course, the most important thing that we do. Our teachers are passionate in their love of teaching and revel in the opportunities at Elmhurst to respond to the interests of their young pupils, shaping a challenging and engaging learning experience.
We are fortunate enough to be able to further capture our pupils’ interest through dedicated subject teachers and their substantial knowledge and enthusiasm for their subject. Drama, Music, PE and Games, Computing and Languages are taught throughout the school by skilled subject specialists, who convey both their understanding and passion for their curriculum area. Additionally, as pupils move through the school, subject specialists in Maths, English and Science deepen the learning and support their interest in making connections beyond the taught curriculum.
The involvement of specialist teachers does not end there. By nature of their interests, specialist teachers play a big part in moving the school forward in their area of responsibility. They are
often well connected and up to date with developments in the subject, enabling the school and our pupils to benefit from their knowledge.
We are privileged to have a Head of Sport who is passionate about creating opportunities where he sees pupils’ brilliance and a Head of Music who is similarly responsive.
There are few schools fortunate enough to have the expertise that Elmhurst does in their Computing department and our Head of IT is good enough to share that expertise with our pupils as well as also contributing to the development of other schools by taking a lead on professional development matters for computing teachers in the wider group.
Whilst our classroom teachers are also experts in their field, it is a real benefit to be able to bring together a common room of broad expertise, united in the shared desire to build brilliant beginnings for every child. The mix is one of the things that makes Elmhurst’s EDGE a tangible reality.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

pageCache.pageTitle: Parents | Prep School London | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
Our Commitment to Parents
Every decision made at our school is done with the best interests of the pupils at its heart. Parents are encouraged to be an active participant in their child’s educational journey and throughout the year, staff will actively engage with parents to involve and inform them about the academic process.
From the very first days in Little Elms, when the family photographs are displayed in the room, pupils and parents are encouraged to be part of the school team that works to nurture your child’s brilliance. We build strong relationships based on mutual respect and our small school means staff are readily accessible and able to help should problems arise.
Throughout the school year we hold workshops for parents, give regular written and oral feedback through parent’s evenings, written reports and open classroom events. We actively look to bring parents together through school events, supported by the EFA and we enjoy real benefits from parent support with reading, libraries and trips.
We enjoy excellent governance through our Bellevue family of schools and regular parent feedback forums and questionnaires provide opportunities for parents to feedback on our work. Additionally, parent ambassadors meet on a termly basis to review school development plans and help shape the direction of the school.
Partnerships are a key strategic pillar for the school in recognition of the great strength the parent – pupil – school communication triangle brings.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

The Elmhurst Family’s Association (EFA) was formed in September 1984 with all parents being automatically members of this Association. Their aim is to organise social events and fundraising activities all for the enrichment of Elmhurst, spending all monies raised on its pupils with the aim of enhancing their school life. You can view the Elmhurst Friends’ Association Constitution here.
The EFA is a great way to meet parents from other year groups and to get more involved in your child’s life at the school.
We hold various events throughout the year such as the Christmas Fair, a Quiz Night and Summer Fair. Through these events, we raise money to give back directly to the students. We also run social events for all the children to enjoy time with their friends, making use of the school’s facilities.
In recent years, we have been able to donate garden games and iPads to the school (which helped enhance the children’s learning in ICT lessons) and even funded exciting outdoor activities such as school trips to Go Ape.
We are an extended Elmhurst Family and our door is always open so come along to our next meeting!
Have a chat with your parent class rep or email efa@elmhurstschool.net if you’re interested in joining the team.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

For any guidance on uniform, please do not hesitate to contact the school on 020 8688 0661 or email us on office@elmhurstschool.net.

pageCache.pageTitle: Pastoral Care | Private School London | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
Building character and supporting well-being
We are committed to fostering a safe, nurturing and inclusive environment where every student feels valued, supported and equipped to thrive both personally and academically.
Pupil well-being encompasses the emotional, mental, physical and social aspects of school life. It is about helping pupils to feel good about themselves, building positive relationships, managing stress and approaching challenges with resilience. Our goal at Elmhurst is to support every child’s holistic development, ensuring they have the tools and confidence to succeed not just in school but in life.
Pastoral Care
We have a supportive pastoral approach in place at Elmhurst to ensure that every child feels cared for throughout their school journey and are able to build brilliant character as well as resilience. Supporting self regulation, our pastoral team are compassionate professionals who are committed to the welfare of each child. They work closely with families to create a supportive and responsive environment.
A Shared Responsibility
We believe that pupil personal development and well-being is vital and is optimal when approaches involves pupils, staff, parents, and, where appropriate, the wider community. By working together, we can create a supportive network that empowers our pupils to grow character and, in time, enable pupils to lead fulfilling, balanced lives.
For more information about our pastoral care services or to discuss any concerns, please contact Mr Brook at brookd@elmhurstschool.net.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

pageCache.pageTitle: Value & Vision | Independent School | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
Beginnings Made Brilliant
Our aim is to be the outstanding 11+ preparatory school in South East London, driven to develop the brilliance in every child, laying the foundations for a happy and successful future for themselves and the wider community.
We believe we can do this through the delivery of forward-thinking educational excellence through a broad and challenging curriculum and a commitment to doing the best we can for ourselves and those around us.
Our EDGE personal development programme brings together school enrichment, experience and partners to shape the pupil journey into a truly brilliant beginning.
We are a KIND, BRAVE, CURIOUS, DETERMINED, RESPECTFUL community.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.

pageCache.pageTitle: Admissions | Private School Surrey | Elmhurst School
pageCache.text:
We are delighted you are considering Elmhurst School for your child. Every pupil who joins Elmhurst is valued and their journey through the school will be a unique one. We aim to ensure every child and family enjoys being part of our community and from the moment you contact us, you can expect us to support you in your decision making.
Our website should give you a sense of what we do at Elmhurst but, of course, we would love to meet you in person. We run Open Days throughout the year as well as Stay and Play sessions for pre-schoolers. For those unable to attend our scheduled sessions, Elmhurst offers private visits to accommodate your schedule. Our admissions team is always ready to assist you in arranging a visit that suits your needs.
Make An Enquiry
Elmhurst School is proud to offer a coeducational environment, welcoming both girls and boys to benefit from our inclusive and dynamic educational experience. By embracing coeducation, we believe in fostering mutual respect, collaboration and a diverse learning atmosphere where all students can thrive together. With small class sizes and a broad and engaging curriculum, demand for places is high so if you are interested in joining our wonderful community, please note the steps below.
If you are ready to move forward with an application to join us at Elmhurst School, here is a step-by-step guide of our Application process.
Scholarships
All pupils applying for places at 7+ will be considered for academic or sporting scholarships at the discretion of the Head and with supporting references.
Our contact details
Should you have any questions about the application process, our Admissions Manager, Miss Fowler can be reached via email on admissions@elmhurstschool.net or by phone on 0208 688 0661. You can also complete our online form and we will get in touch with you shortly.
Join us for our Autumn Open Morning on Saturday, 10th October 2026.
